source: Meetup city search, round 3 (20 metros: CA, FL, TX, AZ, NV, NC, SC, VA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, OK, AR)
note: Verified on each group's own Meetup events page and cross-checked against Meetup's series record. Ten of the seventeen have no street address because the organiser publishes none — one of those deliberately, because Meetup's venue for it is a private home. Those must stay city-level.

excluded.event: Mahjong Cruise on MSC from Galveston
excluded.reason: A cruise sailing from Galveston, listed under the organising group's home city of Denton, 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Not a session anyone can attend in Denton and not at a fixed venue, so listing it under either city would be wrong.

listings.name: Gamelandia — Mahjong Night with Molly
listings.cost: Paid — book through Gamelandia's own store
listings.description: Beginner-friendly mahjong evening at the Gamelandia game store on California Avenue, led by Molly, on alternate Mondays 7-9pm. Seats are limited and must be reserved through Gamelandia's own website — the group does not take RSVPs on Meetup.
listings.howToJoin: Reserve a seat on gamelandia.fun before attending. RSVPs are NOT accepted through Meetup: the store tracks all reservations through its own system.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of San Jose, verified on the group's own events page: 6 upcoming "Gamelandia Mahjong Night with Molly" sessions, all Monday 19:00-21:00. Meetup records "Every 2 weeks on Monday until November 17, 2026", which the dates confirm (7 and 21 Sep, 5 and 19 Oct, 2 and 16 Nov). registrationLink points at the store rather than Meetup because the event description says so outright: "We don't accept RSVPs on MeetUp because all reservations must be done through our own website". STYLE NOT STATED by the organiser — recorded as american on the base rate for US social play (2,472 of 2,744 listings); confirm before relying on it.

listings.name: Mahjong Café Naples — Mahjong Lunch Social
listings.description: An afternoon of American Mahjong, lunch and social play in a sectioned-off private area at Golden Grove Kitchen, run by Mahjong Café Naples. Intended for players who already know the basics rather than complete beginners. Tickets are $30 and must be bought in advance; Meetup places are limited because the event also sells through other platforms.
listings.howToJoin: Pre-purchase a $30 ticket. Meetup is one of several ticketing platforms for this event.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Naples, verified on the group's own events page: 2 upcoming "Mahjong Lunch Social • Naples FL" sessions, 1 and 8 Sep, Tuesday 13:00-16:00. Meetup records "Every week on Tuesday until November 12, 2026". Style, price and the skill expectation are quoted from the event description ("an afternoon of American Mahjong, lunch, and social play in a private setting", "intended for players who already know the basics"). The same organiser has run events at Marco Island Brewery, but none are currently scheduled, so no listing was created for that venue.

listings.name: Cary Mah Jongg — Mah Jongg Monday
listings.description: American Mah Jongg on Monday evenings at Buffalo Brothers in Cary, over food and drinks. Sessions alternate between "Play only", which has no teaching and limited support for learners, and "Learn and play", which welcomes people who are still picking it up. Bring a set if you have one; the organiser has spare American Mah Jongg cards to lend and the group has its own Cary card.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Raleigh, verified on the group's own events page: 3 upcoming Monday 18:30-20:30 sessions (31 Aug, 14 and 21 Sep). Style is stated outright in the description ("playing American Mah Jongg"), as is the card lending. Meetup records no series, and the posted dates are not evenly spaced, so "weekly" follows the "Mah Jongg Monday" name — not every Monday is currently on the calendar. The two event titles are the same session in two modes, not two sessions, so they are one listing.

listings.name: Charleston Riichi Mahjong — Sunday Morning Riichi
listings.description: Sunday morning Riichi Mahjong over coffee and tea at Annie O'Love's Cookie Cafe. Riichi is the Japanese four-player variant. New players are welcome — the club runs a teaching table for anyone who has never played, or who only knows another variant.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Charleston, verified on the group's own events page: "Sunday Morning Riichi Mahjong", Sun 6 Sep 10:00-13:00. Style is explicit — the description reads "Our club plays Riichi, a variant from Japan". Meetup records no series and only one date is posted, so "weekly" follows the recurring session name; re-check if no later dates appear.
